## Technical Knowledge
> Code patterns, frameworks, stack details, and structural information

- **Sync**: Any changes made locally are pushed to GitHub via `git push origin main`. Vercel will listen for these changes and redeploy automatically. _(changes, locally, pushed)_
- **Login**: Go to [Vercel](https://vercel.com/) and sign in with your GitHub account (`SREphoto`). _(login, vercelhttpsvercelcom, github)_
- **Add Domain**: In your Vercel Project dashboard, go to **Settings > Domains**. _(domain, vercel, project)_
- **DNS Records**: Vercel will provide specific values for your DNS. You will need: _(records, vercel, provide)_
- **A Record**: Value `76.76.21.21` (typically). _(record, value, typically)_
- **Google Domains Update**: _(google, domains, update)_
- Log in to your [Google/Squarespace Domains dashboard](https://domains.squarespace.com/). _(googlesquarespace, domains, dashboardhttpsdomainssquarespacecom)_
- Under **Custom records**, create the A and CNAME records with values from Vercel. _(custom, records, create)_
- Delete any old records pointing to Squarespace's "Coming Soon" page. _(delete, records, pointing)_
- **Automatic Deploy**: Whenever you or I commit new code to GitHub, the live site updates in ~60 seconds. _(automatic, deploy, whenever)_
- **SSL/HTTPS**: Vercel provides high-end SSL encryption automatically. _(sslhttps, vercel, provides)_
- @vitejs/plugin-react uses Babel (or oxc when used in rolldown-vite) for Fast Refresh _(vitejspluginreact, babel, rolldownvite)_
- @vitejs/plugin-react-swc uses SWC for Fast Refresh _(vitejspluginreactswc, refresh)_
- If you are developing a production application, we recommend using TypeScript with type-aware lint rules enabled. Check out the TS template for information on how to integrate TypeScript and typescript-eslint in your project. _(developing, production, application)_
- **Frontend**: React (Vite) with `framer-motion` for complex orchestrations. _(frontend, react, framermotion)_
- **Assets**: Uses `lucide-react` for consistent iconography. _(assets, lucidereact, consistent)_
- **Data Sources**: Static data files (`/data/repos`, `/data/midjourney`) powering dynamic project grids. _(sources, static, files)_
- **Dynamic Hero Section**: Atmospheric entry with particle effects and smooth fade-in animations. _(dynamic, section, atmospheric)_
- **Project Showcase**: A filtered grid of work (Web Apps, Automation, AI) with "holographic" card effects. _(project, showcase, filtered)_
- **Media Gallery**: _(media, gallery)_
- **Midjourney Art**: A curated section displaying AI-generated artwork. _(midjourney, curated, section)_
- **Video Hub**: Integration for showcasing demo reels or tutorials. _(video, integration, showcasing)_
- **Contact & Socials**: Polished footer and navigation for professional outreach. _(contact, socials, polished)_
- `/src/App.jsx`: The single-page application structure. _(srcappjsx, singlepage, application)_
- `/src/data`: Contains the content repositories for projects and art, allowing easy updates without code changes. _(srcdata, contains, content)_
